title: RelayTransitEnvelope
description: The v1 transit envelope for every event crossing the relay (ADR-0123 §6, the N1 invariant: sealed or labeled, no third state). A discriminated union on `classification`: `sealed` events are AEAD-encrypted under a key from the account-KMS hierarchy and the relay stores/forwards them without ever reading plaintext (I1); `relay_readable` events are streams the relay legitimately processes (GitHub webhook ingress, fleet-cloud telemetry) and MUST carry a human-readable `reason` naming why this event class is relay-readable — the honest label that replaces plaintext-as-base64 sitting in a field the trust story calls ciphertext. The envelope is the transit BODY of the ADR-0049 chain frame: it serializes as Base64URL JSON into the frame's opaque `ciphertext` slot, so per-(sender,channel) chain hashing (computeEventHash) and skills/pd-relay-zero-trust/scripts/chain_verify.py are unchanged — the chain commits the envelope bytes as an opaque string, and the frame's prev_hash/this_hash therefore live OUTSIDE this envelope (this_hash is computed over the serialized envelope and cannot appear inside it). Routing metadata (harbor, channel, sender, seq, iat) is duplicated into the envelope and covered by `sig` so a valid envelope for one channel/seq cannot be spliced into another — the same end-to-end binding posture as agent-harbor guidance-envelope (ADR-0096: proxies are untrusted plumbing). Tolerant-reader posture per ADR-0095 §6: additionalProperties true; unknown fields are preserved, never silently dropped.

classification.description: AEAD-sealed under the account-KMS hierarchy. The relay verifies STRUCTURE (alg/epoch/nonce/ciphertext present) but can never read the payload; an E2E channel receiving anything else is a crit invariant breach (ADR-0123 §6, ADR-0045 loud-fail).

harbor.description: Harbor fingerprint prefix of the channel — the routing tenant. Matches the outer frame channel's prefix before the first ':'.

channel.description: Full channel string including the harbor prefix, identical to the outer frame's channel. Part of the signed binding: a valid envelope for channel A cannot be spliced into channel B.

sender.description: Sender fingerprint (hex), identical to the outer frame's sender. Part of the signed binding.

seq.description: Per-(sender, channel) chain sequence, identical to the outer frame's seq. Part of the signed binding: a valid envelope for seq 5 cannot be replayed as seq 9.

iat.description: Unix timestamp, identical to the outer frame's iat. Part of the signed binding.

alg.description: AEAD algorithm. Closed enum: aes-256-gcm is the only algorithm in the v1 trust story; additions are additive schema revisions, never silent.

epoch.description: Key epoch under the account-KMS hierarchy (ADR-0123): rotation advances the epoch without re-keying history.

nonce.description: Base64URL AEAD nonce, unique per (key, epoch).

ciphertext.description: Base64URL AEAD ciphertext — genuinely sealed bytes, the only field of this variant the relay cannot interpret.

sig.description: REQUIRED, non-empty. Signature over sha256 of the canonical binding 'pd.relay.envelope.v1|<classification>|<harbor>|<channel>|<sender>|<seq>|<iat>|<content_hash>' where content_hash = sha256 of the `ciphertext` string (sealed) or of the serialized `payload` (relay_readable). key_id carries the signer's key identity — for ed25519 the sender's public key (hex); for hmac-sha256 the shared-secret binding id (interim until pd-vault key ids land).

classification.description: A stream the relay legitimately processes. The label is the honest state ADR-0123 §6 demands: never plaintext masquerading as ciphertext, always an explicit, counted, justified classification.

harbor.description: Harbor fingerprint prefix of the channel — the routing tenant ('github' for the webhook ingress stream). Matches the outer frame channel's prefix before the first ':'.

channel.description: Full channel string including the harbor prefix, identical to the outer frame's channel. Part of the signed binding: a valid envelope for channel A cannot be spliced into channel B.

sender.description: Sender fingerprint (hex), identical to the outer frame's sender. Part of the signed binding.

seq.description: Per-(sender, channel) chain sequence, identical to the outer frame's seq. Part of the signed binding: a valid envelope for seq 5 cannot be replayed as seq 9.

iat.description: Unix timestamp, identical to the outer frame's iat. Part of the signed binding.

payload.description: Structured JSON the relay may read and process. For the GitHub webhook stream: { event_type, delivery_id, action, repository, payload }.

reason.description: REQUIRED human-readable justification for why this event class is relay-readable, e.g. 'github webhook relay: payload is GitHub-public data'. An empty or missing reason makes the envelope invalid — the label is not optional decoration, it is the audit trail.

sig.description: REQUIRED, non-empty. Same binding construction as the sealed variant: sha256 of 'pd.relay.envelope.v1|<classification>|<harbor>|<channel>|<sender>|<seq>|<iat>|<content_hash>' with content_hash = sha256 of the serialized `payload`. For relay-ingested streams (GitHub webhook) the relay signs with its own ed25519 key: the signature attests 'the relay ingested this from a verified origin', not sender authorship.
